mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, stimulating equity markets and yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeding 5% YoY signals strong supply-side momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth outpacing CPI (CPIAUCSL) inflation by more than 2% predicts increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) hike above 2.5% within a quarter predicts a monetary policy-driven downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low and stable unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4%) is associated with a strong labor market, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth slowing down by more than 1% YoY, indicating weakening demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only in late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances during late-cycle expansions.
